    The year's multipliers of the expected ignitions and of the expected escapes, per cell

    yearMultipliers.Rd

    fireSenseUtils::yearEffectMultiplier() of each sd layer (yearSDLayer()) and the year's z (1 without z). With fitted, a cell's fitted multiplier (layers ignitionYearEffect and escapeYearEffect, from fireSense_ignitionPredict) replaces it where it is not NA, times a draw from its posterior: with the layer <process>YearEffectShape, w = qgamma(p, shape, rate = shape) (mean 1), one uniform p per call and process, shared by every cell (several ELFs share it, as they share z), so each rep-year draws its own effect and the reps keep the uncertainty of the year's effect (fireSense_ignitionFit's fittedYearEffects()). shape NA, or no shape layer: w = 1. The uniforms are drawn only when there is a fitted layer, so the random numbers of fitted = FALSE are unchanged.

    yearMultipliers(probRas, z, fitted = FALSE)

    Arguments

    probRas

    fireSense_IgAndEscapeProbRas.

    z

    The year's z (yearZ()), or NULL.

    fitted

    Use the fitted multipliers where there are.

    Value

    A list of two numeric vectors, one value per cell: ignition and escape.
